none: PAS NCL-7C6E33: NCL-7C6E33: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is approximately circular in shape, within which is a raised panel which is rectangular in shape and section. The raised panel is struck with a rectangular die with the legend 'LVI' in relief. On the underside of the sealing is a further stamped rectangular panel which is situated at a 90 degree angle to the one on the upper surface.…
